title: PAWP-TTS: Phoneme-Aware Weight Programming for Compact Bilingual English-Nepali Speech Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2611.29455v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents PAWP-TTS, a compact non-autoregressive text-to-speech system for English, Nepali, and English-Nepali code-mixed speech at 24 kHz, with no language model at inference. Deterministic pronunciation knowledge lives in a rule- and lexicon-based bilingual frontend that preserves native Nepali contrasts and avoids Hindi phonology, so the network only models acoustics. Counting every learned inference tensor, including the waveform decoder, PAWP-1.5M (1,490,390 parameters, 5.98 MB) reaches 1.50% English and 1.75% Nepali character error rate under a single ASR recognizer, and 5.04% / 4.02% Nepali / English phoneme error rate (PER) on 600 untouched test utterances. Decoder-centric 281K-parameter models (1.1 MB) stay intelligible across three independent seeds, with equal-budget dense models (5.53 +/- 0.08% NE, 5.34 +/- 0.28% EN PER) outperforming K=2 cross-layer shared-basis models (6.35 +/- 0.11% NE, 6.57 +/- 0.47% EN PER). translated_title: PAWP-TTS：面向紧凑型英-尼泊尔语双语语音合成的音素感知权重编程
translated_abstract: 本文提出了PAWP-TTS，一个紧凑的非自回归文本转语音系统，支持英语、尼泊尔语以及英-尼泊尔语混合编码语音，采样率为24 kHz，且推理时无需语言模型。确定性的发音知识被置于基于规则和词典的双语前端中，该前端保留了尼泊尔语的原生语音对比并避免印地语语音体系的影响，从而使网络只需建模声学部分。计入所有学习到的推理张量（包括波形解码器），PAWP-1.5M（1,490,390个参数，5.98 MB）在单一ASR识别器下达到1.50%的英语和1.75%的尼泊尔语字符错误率，并在600条未参与训练的测试语句上达到5.04%/4.02%的尼泊尔语/英语音素错误率（PER）。以解码器为中心的281K参数模型（1.1 MB）在三个独立随机种子下均保持可懂度，其中同等参数预算的密集模型（尼泊尔语5.53 ± 0.08%，英语5.34 ± 0.28% PER）优于K=2跨层共享基模型（尼泊尔语6.35 ± 0.11%，英语6.57 ± 0.47% PER）。
tldr: PAWP-TTS通过将确定性发音知识交由基于规则和词典的音素感知双语前端处理，使网络仅需建模声学，从而以仅5.98 MB、149万参数的紧凑非自回归模型实现了高质量的英语-尼泊尔语双语及混合编码语音合成。
en_tdlr: PAWP-TTS achieves compact bilingual English-Nepali speech synthesis by offloading deterministic pronunciation knowledge to a rule- and lexicon-based phoneme-aware frontend, enabling a mere 1.5M-parameter non-autoregressive network to model only acoustics with low character and phoneme error rates.
